name: Mini Golf
hook: Everyone putts at the same time.
how: Drag back and let go to putt. Everyone plays the same hole at once and sees the other balls roll. Fewest strokes over six holes wins.
controls: Drag back and let go, with a mouse or a finger
uses: The fewest strokes for a full round of the course.
The host's browser runs the hole timer and the scorecard; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots putt alongside you until enough people join.
Every ball rolls for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a windmill with real blades in front of the cup
Add a hole where the floor tilts
Make it a space course with low gravity
